## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmation: (1) Utilities, Energy and Healthcare are showing clear 1W strength while Technology and Financials are weak, and (2) top performers are spread across multiple sectors (Leadership: Broad). Style mixed / no clear leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND and SO showing positive headlines; Communication strong: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare leadership: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Financials lag: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND and GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND; Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary soft: AMZN (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND and TSLA (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY, INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY, NEM (1W: +6.44% | 1M: -1.48%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -10.08%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated (Leadership: Narrow; 3/5 Financials).

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W moves: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY, INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND — note tactical divergences: several names show 1W rebound vs negative 1M (RECOVERY), monitor for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology mixed but biased weak: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY — sector 1W negative and under pressure.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials underperforming: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND and AXP (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND — breadth negative (Financials a net drag).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare constructive: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +1.13% | 1M: -0.26%) RECOVERY — sector showing resilient leadership.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
In a NEUTRAL regime favor selective exposure to Utilities, Energy and Healthcare names showing ABOVE TREND strength and reduce exposure to broadly weak Financials and large-cap Tech that remain BELOW TREND; monitor RECOVERY names (PYPL, INTU, CRM) for confirmation before adding exposure. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND, EQIX (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, AXP (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Utilities (CEG ABOVE TREND) and Energy (XOM (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +11.58%) ABOVE TREND) given 1W strength; BEARISH: Financials and Technology remain at risk and merit monitoring for further downside or defensive rotation.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA reclaim of near-term resistance required for trend stabilization (NVDA BELOW TREND); AAPL holding recent pullback area would keep CORRECTION intact (AAPL CORRECTION); JPM break lower would deepen Financials weakness (JPM BELOW TREND); JNJ holding its ABOVE TREND range is a positive sign for healthcare leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+60): Eli Lilly (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment (oral GLP‑1 / Olumiant) confirming price strength. PFE (+60): Pfizer (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND — positive clinical news aligning with upside.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
PYPL (-65): PayPal (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY — news negative but price up (divergence; distribution risk). WFC (-55): Wells Fargo (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms price weakness. INTU (-50): Intuit (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY — downgrade headline but strong 1W bounce (watch for follow-through). IBM (-50): IBM (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price in agreement.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; style mixed / no clear leadership. LLY, JNJ and NFLX showing relative strength (LLY ABOVE TREND; JNJ ABOVE TREND; NFLX ABOVE TREND). Key risk: concentrated Financials weakness and multiple RECOVERY-name divergences (PYPL, INTU, CRM) that require follow-through before shifting stance.
